title: Cassian Andor
description: The adopted son of Clem and Maarva Andor, Cassian Andor lived on Ferrix. Luthen Rael recruited Andor for a heist on Aldhani. After escaping prison on Narkina 5, Andor returned to Ferix for her mother's funeral. Maarva's holographic message touched off an uprising against the Imperials on the planet. After the riot, Andor had a tense reunion with Rael.
